en.summary: This mixed RTL commit clearly fixes a front-end warp-lock release bug. A warp is now unlocked on an accepted I-cache response event instead of on a derived valid-mask condition that was also blocked by local stall state.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly names a warp scheduler lock bug.
The patch changes scheduler/front-end RTL interfaces and the lock-release condition itself.
The new icache_stage_response signal is generated from a real response-pop event and used to release warp_lock.
disqualifiers: The commit also bundles several unrelated RTL fixes and large runtime artifacts.
evidence: VX_warp_sched.v changes unlock from (| icache_stage_valids) && !stall to icache_stage_response.
VX_icache_stage.v replaces icache_stage_valids with icache_stage_response and defines it as mrq_pop, i.e. an accepted I-cache response.
VX_fetch.v and VX_front_end.v propagate the new response-based unlock signal through the front-end interface.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A fetch scheduler that locks an execution context after issuing an instruction fetch must release that lock when the matching fetch response is actually accepted. If unlock is instead tied to a derived decode-valid indication or is suppressed by unrelated stall state, the response can arrive without clearing the lock, leaving the context permanently unschedulable.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A warp or thread group has been locked after fetch issue, and the instruction-cache response returns while local stall or valid-mask conditions do not match the old derived unlock predicate.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Replace the accepted-response unlock event with a derived valid-mask signal and/or gate unlock with local stall.
portability_notes: Any front-end that tracks outstanding fetches with a per-context lock can exhibit this bug.
The important distinction is accepted response handshake versus downstream decoded-valid indication.
If the target DUT uses a queue tag or response-pop event, that event is the correct anchor to mutate.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the state bit that prevents a context from being rescheduled while an instruction fetch is outstanding.
Find the event that clears that bit on fetch completion.
Replace the completion event with a weaker derived signal such as decoded thread valids, or add an unrelated stall guard to the unlock path.
Keep the lock-acquire path unchanged so the reinjected failure is specifically an unlock omission.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: front-end warp_lock release on I-cache response
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix introduces icache_stage_response as a response-pop event from VX_icache_stage and uses it in VX_warp_sched to clear warp_lock without the old stall-gated valid-mask condition.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change VX_warp_sched back to unlocking on (| icache_stage_valids) && !stall, and propagate a valid-mask-style signal from the I-cache stage instead of the response-pop event.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A warp can stay locked after its fetch response arrives, producing front-end stalls or a full forward-progress hang.
evidence_for_injection: The commit creates a dedicated response event solely to fix unlock timing.
The old and new unlock predicates are both visible in the diff, so the reverse mutation is concrete.
The interface changes across VX_icache_stage, VX_fetch, and VX_front_end show this is a real protocol correction, not a local cleanup.
notes: Other RTL fixes in the commit are real but not needed for this injection target.
This injection is portable to any fetch pipeline that locks contexts until instruction return.

zh.summary: 这个混合 RTL 提交中有一处明确的前端 warp-lock 释放修复。修复后，warp 会在 I-cache 响应真正被接收时解锁，而不是依赖一个从 valid-mask 推导出的条件，并且旧条件还会被本地 stall 状态额外阻塞。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确点名了 warp scheduler lock bug。
补丁同时修改了调度器/前端 RTL 接口以及 lock-release 条件本身。
新的 icache_stage_response 由真实的 I-cache 响应 pop 事件生成，并被用于释放 warp_lock。
disqualifiers: 该提交还捆绑了多个无关 RTL 修复以及大量 runtime 产物。
evidence: VX_warp_sched.v 把解锁条件从 (| icache_stage_valids) && !stall 改成了 icache_stage_response。
VX_icache_stage.v 用 icache_stage_response 替代 icache_stage_valids，并把它定义为 mrq_pop，也就是真实被接收的 I-cache 响应。
VX_fetch.v 和 VX_front_end.v 把这个基于响应的解锁信号沿前端接口继续向上传递。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 如果前端调度器在发出取指后会锁住某个执行上下文，那么它必须在对应的取指响应真正被接收时释放该锁。如果解锁依赖的是解码 valid 这类派生信号，或者又被无关的 stall 状态额外门控，那么即使响应已经返回，锁也可能不会清除，导致该上下文永久无法再次调度。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 基于取指响应的调度器锁释放
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个 warp 或线程组在发出 fetch 后已被锁住，而 I-cache 响应返回时，本地 stall 或 valid-mask 条件不满足旧的派生解锁谓词。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把基于真实响应接收的解锁事件改回派生 valid-mask 信号，或重新加上本地 stall 门控。
portability_notes: 任何使用每上下文 lock 来跟踪未完成 fetch 的前端都可能出现此类缺陷。
关键区别在于：正确事件是“响应握手已完成”，而不是“下游 decode 看到某些 valid”。
如果目标 DUT 使用队列 tag 或 response-pop 事件，那就是最合适的注入锚点。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到用于阻止某个上下文在取指未完成时再次被调度的状态位。
定位该状态位在 fetch 完成后被清除的事件。
把该清除事件替换成更弱的派生信号，例如 decoded thread valids，或者在解锁路径上增加无关 stall 条件。
保持加锁路径不变，使回注缺陷集中表现为“解锁遗漏”。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: I-cache 响应驱动的前端 warp_lock 释放
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复通过在 VX_icache_stage 中引入代表 response-pop 的 icache_stage_response，并在 VX_warp_sched 中用它替代旧的 stall-gated valid-mask 解锁条件。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 VX_warp_sched 改回用 (| icache_stage_valids) && !stall 解锁，并在 I-cache stage 到前端之间重新传递 valid-mask 风格的信号，而不是 response-pop 事件。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 某个 warp 在取指响应到达后仍保持锁定，导致前端停顿，严重时会完全失去前进能力。
evidence_for_injection: 该提交专门新增了一个响应事件来修复解锁时机。
diff 中同时给出了旧解锁谓词和新解锁谓词，因此可逆向注入非常具体。
VX_icache_stage、VX_fetch、VX_front_end 的接口同步变更说明这是真实协议修复，而不是局部清理。
notes: 提交中的其他 RTL 修复虽然真实存在，但不是本次注入目标所必需的部分。
该注入可迁移到任何在指令返回前锁住执行上下文的 fetch 流水线。
